question: What is the average projected monthly sales in USD for France in 2021, considering only product sales with promotions where promo_total_id = 1 and channels where channel_total_id = 1, by taking each product’s monthly sales from 2019 and 2020, calculating the growth rate from 2019 to 2020 for that same product and month, applying this growth rate to project 2021 monthly sales, converting all projected 2021 amounts to USD with the 2021 exchange rates, and finally averaging and listing them by month?
sql:
WITH sales_2019 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2019
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2019
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
sales_2020 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.prod_id,
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(s.amount_sold) as monthly_sales_2020
    FROM sales s
    JOIN customers cu ON s.cust_id = cu.cust_id
    JOIN countries c ON cu.country_id = c.country_id
    JOIN times t ON s.time_id = t.time_id
    WHERE c.country_name = 'France'
    AND s.channel_id IN (SELECT channel_id FROM channels WHERE channel_total_id = 1)
    AND s.promo_id IN (SELECT promo_id FROM promotions WHERE promo_total_id = 1)
    AND t.calendar_year = 2020
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, t.calendar_month_number
),
growth_rates AS (
    SELECT 
        s2019.prod_id,
        s2019.calendar_month_number,
        ((s2020.monthly_sales_2020 - s2019.monthly_sales_2019) / NULLIF(s2019.monthly_sales_2019, 0)) as growth_rate
    FROM sales_2019 s2019
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON s2019.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND s2019.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
projected_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        g.prod_id,
        g.calendar_month_number,
        (g.growth_rate * s2020.monthly_sales_2020) + s2020.monthly_sales_2020 as projected_2021_sales
    FROM growth_rates g
    JOIN sales_2020 s2020 ON g.prod_id = s2020.prod_id AND g.calendar_month_number = s2020.calendar_month_number
),
monthly_avg_2021 AS (
    SELECT 
        t.calendar_month_number,
        SUM(cur.to_us) as exchange_rate,
        AVG(p.projected_2021_sales * cur.to_us) as avg_projected_sales_usd
    FROM projected_2021 p
    JOIN times t ON p.calendar_month_number = t.calendar_month_number
    JOIN currency cur ON cur.country = 'France' AND cur.year = 2021 AND cur.month = t.calendar_month_number
    GROUP BY t.calendar_month_number
)
SELECT * FROM monthly_avg_2021 ORDER BY calendar_month_number
